ammo_cache.desc: Forward stores: men within 7 m top up their rounds, grenades and rockets till it runs dry, and men out of ammunition fall back to it. Cooks off if it's hit hard.
ammo_cache.name: Ammo Cache

at_post.desc: Crewed anti-tank launcher (guided missile / recoilless rifle). Kills vehicles out to 130 m.
at_post.name: AT Post

barricade.desc: Oil drums, tyres, rubble and scrap, chest high: stand and fire over it. Tanks shove it aside, and the tyres burn.
barricade.name: Barricade

bunker.desc: Pillbox with firing slits and a roof that stops shrapnel. Right-click it with a squad to garrison.
bunker.name: Bunker

camo_net.desc: Pitch it over a gun pit, a mortar or a parked vehicle: anything under it is spotted at half the range, from the ground or the air. It stops nothing.
camo_net.name: Camouflage Net

concrete_wall.desc: Precast concrete slabs, too tall to see over: complete protection behind them. Soldiers lean around the ends. Light vehicles can't push through.
concrete_wall.name: T-Wall

dock.desc: Builds boats. On the shore of the sea or the river, facing open water, on your own half of the map.
dock.name: Boat Dock

fob.desc: Forward base: +20 unit cap, ammo, lays a supply road.
fob.name: FOB

helipad.desc: Builds helicopters and drones. Supply helicopters fly over cut roads straight to your FOBs.
helipad.name: Helipad

hesco.desc: Earth-filled cells, chest high and a metre thick: stand and fire over it. Stops even a .50 cal, and blocks vehicles.
hesco.name: HESCO Barrier

hmg_nest.desc: Heavy machine gun: 100 m range, crushing suppression, shreds trucks, technicals, helicopters and drones.
hmg_nest.name: .50 Cal Nest

medic_tent.desc: Stretcher bearers bring back the wounded and the dead.
medic_tent.name: Medic Tent

mg_nest.desc: Sandbagged GPMG. A nearby soldier crews it and pins down infantry.
mg_nest.name: MG Nest

mines.desc: Hidden. Blows up vehicles and infantry.
mines.name: Minefield

mortar_pit.desc: Crewed mortar. Shells enemies your side can see, even behind cover (30-160 m). Select it for fire missions.
mortar_pit.name: Mortar Pit

sandbags.desc: Low cover. Crouch and pop up to shoot.
sandbags.name: Sandbags

tank_trap.desc: A Czech hedgehog of welded steel. Blocks vehicles (and supply trucks).
tank_trap.name: Tank Trap

trench.desc: Soldiers stand half a metre below ground: only their heads show when they fire. Drag to dig a line.
trench.name: Trench

tunnel.desc: Move squads through the tunnel network. Prisoners are interrogated here.
tunnel.name: Tunnel Entrance

watchtower.desc: Sees 85 m over the hedges and roofs, 115 m with a lookout up it (any idle soldier beside it climbs up). Shoots over walls.
watchtower.name: Watchtower

crew.desc: Bailed out of a knocked-out vehicle: they make for the nearest FOB, to crew another.
crew.name: Tank Crew

engineer_team.desc: Build twice as fast, repair tracks and buildings.
engineer_team.name: Engineers

fpv_team.desc: Flies kamikaze drones into soldiers and tanks.
fpv_team.name: FPV Team

mg_team.desc: Machine gun that pins enemies down.
mg_team.name: MG Team

mortar_team.desc: Mobile mortar. Shells enemies your side has spotted, even behind cover. F = fire mission.
mortar_team.name: Mortar Team

pkm_team.desc: Machine gun that pins enemies down.
pkm_team.name: PKM Team

r_crew.desc: Bailed out of a knocked-out vehicle: they make for the nearest FOB, to crew another.
r_crew.name: Tank Crew

r_mortar_team.desc: Mobile mortar. Shells enemies your side has spotted, even behind cover. F = fire mission.
r_mortar_team.name: Mortar Team

a10.desc: The Warthog comes in low and walks a burst of 30 mm through the spot: the impacts first, then the BRRRT. Drag to set the strafing line.
a10.name: A-10C Thunderbolt II Gun Run
a10.pattern: Fairchild Republic A-10C Thunderbolt II, 30 mm GAU-8/A Avenger

ac130.desc: Spooky orbits overhead for 25 seconds, port wing down, hunting anything in the circle with its side-firing 105, 40 and 25 mm. You hear the guns, then the rounds arrive.
ac130.name: AC-130U Spooky Gunship
ac130.pattern: Lockheed AC-130U Spooky II: 105 mm M102 howitzer, 40 mm Bofors, 25 mm GAU-12 Equalizer

airstrike.desc: A stealth fighter runs in and drops a stick of four bombs across the spot. Devastating in the open. Drag to set the run-in direction.
airstrike.name: F/A-181 Black Wasp II Strike
airstrike.pattern: F/A-181 Black Wasp II (Super Hornet / F-22 hybrid), four 500 lb bombs

artillery.desc: Eight heavy howitzer shells. Brings down buildings and digs out trenches.
artillery.name: 155 mm Artillery

barrage.desc: Off-map launchers saturate the area with sixteen rockets. Inaccurate, but nobody likes being under it.
barrage.name: Rocket Barrage

blackfish.desc: The tiltrotor gunship orbits overhead for 25 seconds hunting anything in the circle with 105 mm, 40 mm and 20 mm - fewer heavy rounds than Spooky, and cheaper.
blackfish.name: V-44X Blackfish Gunship
blackfish.pattern: V-44X Blackfish (enlarged V-22 / V-280 tiltrotor), 105 mm howitzer, 40 mm and 20 mm cannon

buzzard.desc: The allied light attack jet strafes the line with its 20 mm gun pod. Cheaper and lighter than the Wipeout. Drag to set the strafing line.
buzzard.name: A-143 Buzzard Strafe
buzzard.pattern: A-143 Buzzard (Aero L-159 ALCA), twin 20 mm gun pod

caesar_spotter.desc: A smuggler's light plane droning low along the line, a man with binoculars at the window: slow, so what's under it shows for longer, everything within 80 m either side of its track. Cheap. Drag to set the line.
caesar_spotter.name: Caesar BTT Spotter Flight
caesar_spotter.pattern: Caesar BTT (Cessna TTx), a smuggler's light plane, a spotter with binoculars in the right seat

fenghuang_watch.desc: CSAT lends a Fenghuang: it circles the spot for most of a minute and shows your side everything within 80 m of it.
fenghuang_watch.name: KH-3A Fenghuang Overwatch
fenghuang_watch.pattern: KH-3A Fenghuang (CASC CH-3A Rainbow), its missiles left off for fuel

greyhawk.desc: An armed drone circles the spot for 25 seconds firing guided missiles at whatever it finds there.
greyhawk.name: MQ-4A Greyhawk Drone
greyhawk.pattern: MQ-4A Greyhawk (MQ-9 Reaper layout), six Skalpel missiles

greyhawk_watch.desc: An unarmed Greyhawk circles high over the spot for a minute, its camera turret on it: your side sees everything within 85 m of it until it goes home.
greyhawk_watch.name: MQ-4A Greyhawk Overwatch
greyhawk_watch.pattern: MQ-4A Greyhawk (MQ-9 Reaper layout), unarmed, sensor turret

gryphon.desc: Two guided bombs, close together, exactly on the spot. Drag to set the run-in direction.
gryphon.name: A-149 Gryphon Precision Strike
gryphon.pattern: A-149 Gryphon (Saab JAS 39 Gripen), two laser-guided bombs

gryphon_recon.desc: A Gripen with a recce pod runs along the line at height: everything within 100 m either side of its track shows up for your side as it goes over, the strip stays lit a few seconds while the pictures are read, and what it saw stays on the map as intelligence. Drag to set the line.
gryphon_recon.name: A-149 Gryphon Recon Pass
gryphon_recon.pattern: A-149 Gryphon (Saab JAS 39 Gripen) carrying a reconnaissance pod

mortars.desc: Off-map mortars drop twelve rounds on the spot.
mortars.name: Mortar Barrage

neophron.desc: CSAT's light attack jet walks its 30 mm cannon along the line. Drag to set the strafing line.
neophron.name: To-199 Neophron Strafe

sentinel.desc: A stealth drone drops two bombs on the spot. The enemy gets no warning. Drag to set the run-in direction.
sentinel.name: UCAV Sentinel Strike
sentinel.pattern: UCAV Sentinel (Northrop Grumman X-47B), two GBU-12

shikra.desc: A CSAT stealth fighter drops three bombs across the spot. Drag to set the run-in direction.
shikra.name: To-201 Shikra Bomb Run
shikra.pattern: To-201 Shikra (Sukhoi Su-57 / Su-35), three KAB-250 bombs

smoke.desc: Mortar smoke rounds screen the area (observer demo).
smoke.name: Smoke Screen

wipeout.desc: The Wipeout walks a burst of 30 mm through the spot. You'll see it, and the impacts, before you hear it. Drag to set the strafing line.
wipeout.name: A-164 Wipeout Gun Run
wipeout.pattern: A-164 Wipeout (Arma's A-10 successor), 30 mm GAU-8 Avenger

xian.desc: A CSAT VTOL gunship circles the spot for 25 seconds raking it with 30 mm and rockets.
xian.name: Y-32 Xi'an Gunship
xian.pattern: Y-32 Xi'an VTOL gunship, 30 mm cannon and Skyfire rockets

armour_doctrine.desc: Unlocks tier 2: main battle tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, anti-aircraft vehicles and attack helicopters.
armour_doctrine.name: Armoured Warfare

combined_arms.desc: Unlocks tier 3: self-propelled artillery, the heaviest tanks, drones and the UGV.
combined_arms.name: Combined Arms

csat_advisers.desc: CSAT advisers bring tier 2: tanks, IFVs, anti-aircraft vehicles and attack helicopters.
csat_advisers.name: Foreign Advisers

csat_corps.desc: A CSAT expeditionary corps brings tier 3: artillery, the T-140 and the Futura, drones.
csat_corps.name: Expeditionary Corps

medicine.desc: Patch up and bleed out 50% slower.
medicine.name: Field Medicine

aa_tech.desc: Twin 23 mm cannon on a pickup. Tears helicopters, drones and anything soft apart.
aa_tech.name: AA Technical

angara.desc: Unmanned turret, crew capsule in the hull, reactive armour everywhere: the heaviest thing CSAT sends.
angara.name: T-140 Angara

angara_k.desc: Command variant: a remote 30 mm on the roof and a passive radar that spots for the whole force.
angara_k.name: T-140K Angara
angara_k.pattern: T-14 Armata with a remote 30 mm turret

blackfoot.desc: Stealthy attack helicopter: chin 20 mm, rockets and anti-tank missiles.
blackfoot.name: AH-99 Blackfoot

bobcat.desc: Dozer blade, crane and a remote .50: repairs and recovers vehicles under fire, pushes through wrecks.
bobcat.name: CRV-6e Bobcat

btr.desc: Eight-wheeled APC with a 14.5 mm gun. Carries a fighter cell.
btr.name: BTR

cheetah.desc: Twin 35 mm guns and eight missiles under a search radar: no helicopter or drone lives long near it.
cheetah.name: IFV-6a Cheetah
cheetah.pattern: Namer hull with a Marksman twin 35 mm turret

darter.desc: Quadcopter: circles a spot and shows everything within 70 m to your side. Cheap, quiet, easy to shoot down.
darter.name: AR-2 Darter

falcon.desc: Unmanned helicopter: circles where you send it, spotting, and puts anti-tank missiles into armour.
falcon.name: MQ-12 Falcon

fenghuang_uav.desc: Canard-winged drone: circles where it's sent, spotting, and fires small anti-tank missiles.
fenghuang_uav.name: KH-3A Fenghuang

fia_truck.desc: Dropside truck: brings a whole fighter cell up the road.
fia_truck.name: Truck

futura.desc: A 75 mm railgun: a round that goes through anything, every six seconds.
futura.name: T-100X Futura
futura.pattern: T-100 hull with an experimental railgun turret

ghosthawk.desc: Air assault: flies a rifle squad in, door gunners firing, lands, they pile out, it flies home.
ghosthawk.name: UH-80 Ghost Hawk

ghosthawk_stub.desc: Ghost Hawk with stub wings and rocket pods: a gunship that can still take a door gunner's view.
ghosthawk_stub.name: UH-80 Ghost Hawk (Stub Wings)
ghosthawk_stub.pattern: Black Hawk with ESSS stub wings

gorgon.desc: Eight-wheeled IFV: 30 mm cannon, four anti-tank missiles, a fire team in the back.
gorgon.name: AFV-4 Gorgon

gun_trawler.desc: A steel fishing boat with a twin 23 mm cannon welded on the foredeck: shreds helicopters, light boats and anything on the beach.
gun_trawler.name: Gun Trawler

gunship.desc: Circles its target firing a 30 mm chain gun and rocket salvos. Dreads .50 cals and AA technicals.
gunship.name: Attack Helicopter

heli.desc: Keeps flying supply straight to your neediest FOB, ignoring roads. Can be shot down.
heli.name: Supply Helicopter

hellcat.desc: Wildcat with miniguns and rocket pods: a light gunship for the allied army.
hellcat.name: WY-55 Hellcat

hemtt.desc: Eight-wheeled truck with benches for a full rifle squad.
hemtt.name: HEMTT Transport

hemtt_ammo.desc: Rearms troops and vehicles parked within 13 m: magazines, grenades, missiles.
hemtt_ammo.name: HEMTT Ammo

hemtt_medical.desc: Treats the wounded within 11 m: patches men up and gets the downed back on their feet.
hemtt_medical.name: HEMTT Medical

hemtt_repair.desc: Mobile workshop: repairs vehicles within 13 m and fixes thrown tracks.
hemtt_repair.name: HEMTT Repair

hummingbird.desc: Little Bird with outboard benches: drops a fire team anywhere on the map in seconds, then flies home.
hummingbird.name: MH-9 Hummingbird

humvee.desc: Fast armoured car with a roof .50 cal. Scouts, hunts technicals, shreds soft targets.
humvee.name: Humvee

hunter.desc: Mine-resistant, ambush-protected. Carries a fire team through small-arms fire and roadside bombs.
hunter.name: Hunter

hunter_gmg.desc: M-ATV with a 40 mm grenade machine gun: lobs high explosive into trenches and behind walls.
hunter_gmg.name: Hunter GMG

hunter_hmg.desc: M-ATV with a remote .50 cal: scouts, escorts convoys, shreds technicals.
hunter_hmg.name: Hunter HMG

huron.desc: Twin-rotor heavy lifter: flies twice the supply of the light helicopter to your neediest FOB, ignoring roads.
huron.name: CH-67 Huron

ifrit.desc: Angular armoured car: carries a fighter team through rifle fire.
ifrit.name: Ifrit

ifrit_gmg.desc: Karatel with a remote grenade machine gun.
ifrit_gmg.name: Ifrit GMG

ifv.desc: Tracked infantry fighting vehicle. Carries a fire team into the fight; its 25 mm airburst rounds burst right over trenches.
ifv.name: IFV

kajman.desc: Flying tank: coaxial rotors, a 30 mm chin gun, rocket pods and anti-tank missiles.
kajman.name: Mi-48 Kajman
kajman.pattern: Mi-28 cockpit, Ka-52 rotors, Mi-24 cabin

kamysh.desc: Tracked heavy IFV: 30 mm cannon, four anti-tank missiles and a fighter team. Fast for its weight.
kamysh.name: BTR-K Kamysh
kamysh.pattern: BM-2T Stalker with a Samson 30 mm turret

kuma.desc: Leopard 2 with slat and appliqué armour: the fastest tank on the field and a long 120 mm.
kuma.name: MBT-52 Kuma

m900.desc: A stolen civilian helicopter: four fighters, anywhere, once.
m900.name: M900

marid.desc: Six-wheeled APC with twin remote guns (HMG and GMG): carries a fighter team.
marid.name: MSE-3 Marid

marshall.desc: Fast eight-wheeled IFV with a 40 mm cannon. Carries a fire team.
marshall.name: AMV-7 Marshall
marshall.pattern: Patria AMV with a 40 mm turret (Denel Badger)

mb4wd_at.desc: Open jeep with a recoilless rifle: shoot and scoot.
mb4wd_at.name: MB 4WD AT

mb4wd_lmg.desc: Open jeep with an LMG on the roll bar: a fast raider.
mb4wd_lmg.name: MB 4WD LMG
mb4wd_lmg.pattern: Jeep Wrangler with a light machine gun

mohawk.desc: Three-engined transport: flies a rifle squad in, lands, drops them, flies home - or carries a Humvee, a technical or an APC on its sling.
mohawk.name: CH-49 Mohawk

mora.desc: Warrior-pattern tracked IFV: 30 mm cannon and a fire team, tougher than the wheeled ones.
mora.name: FV-720 Mora

motorboat.desc: A stolen pleasure boat with a PKM on the bow rail: four fighters across the river or along the coast.
motorboat.name: Armed Motorboat

nyx_aa.desc: Two four-round missile pods: a cheap, quick answer to enemy helicopters.
nyx_aa.name: AWC 302 Nyx (AA)
nyx_aa.pattern: Rheinmetall Wiesel AWC with Stinger-class missiles

nyx_ac.desc: Tiny tracked carrier with a 20 mm cannon: quick, hard to spot, hits light vehicles hard.
nyx_ac.name: AWC 304 Nyx (Autocannon)

nyx_at.desc: Wiesel with six fire-and-forget anti-tank missiles and a .50 cal.
nyx_at.name: AWC 301 Nyx (AT)

nyx_recon.desc: Unarmed: a compact radar and an extending periscope see 110 m, for your artillery and your tanks.
nyx_recon.name: AWC 303 Nyx (Recon)
nyx_recon.pattern: Rheinmetall Wiesel AWC with radar and periscope

offroad.desc: A pickup with four fighters in the bed. Fast, cheap, unprotected.
offroad.name: Offroad

offroad_at.desc: SPG-9 recoilless rifle in the bed: a cheap tank killer that can't take a hit.
offroad_at.name: Offroad AT
offroad_at.pattern: Pickup with an SPG-9 recoilless rifle

offroad_hmg.desc: The guerrilla's workhorse: a .50 cal on a pedestal in a pickup bed.
offroad_hmg.name: Offroad HMG
offroad_hmg.pattern: Pickup with an M2 .50 in the bed

offroad_repair.desc: Tools and spares: repairs vehicles within 13 m.
offroad_repair.name: Offroad Repair

old_tank.desc: Smashes walls. Small arms bounce off.
old_tank.name: Old Tank

orca.desc: Fast utility helicopter: flies a fighter cell anywhere on the map and drops them.
orca.name: PO-30 Orca

orca_armed.desc: Ka-60 with a minigun and rocket pods: a light gunship.
orca_armed.name: PO-30 Orca (Armed)
orca_armed.pattern: Kamov Ka-60 with a minigun and rockets

panther.desc: Tank-hull APC with tank armour: a whole rifle squad and a remote GMG/HMG. The safest ride on the field.
panther.name: IFV-6c Panther

patrol_ship.desc: Twenty-five metres of aluminium hull and a stabilised 25 mm cannon: owns the coast, shoots up anything on the shore.
patrol_ship.name: Patrol Ship

pawnee.desc: Little Bird with two miniguns and rocket pods: fast, nimble and fragile.
pawnee.name: AH-9 Pawnee

prowler.desc: Open-topped and very fast: gets a fire team somewhere in a hurry. Nothing stops a bullet.
prowler.name: Prowler

prowler_at.desc: Tank hunter: a Titan launcher on the roll cage, six missiles.
prowler_at.name: Prowler AT

prowler_hmg.desc: Fast raider with a .50 cal on the roll cage.
prowler_hmg.name: Prowler HMG

qilin.desc: Open light strike vehicle: a fighter team, fast.
qilin.name: Qilin

qilin_at.desc: LSV with a Vorona missile launcher: hit-and-run against armour.
qilin_at.name: Qilin AT
qilin_at.pattern: ST Kinetics LSV Mk II with Vorona missiles

qilin_mg.desc: LSV with a 6.5 mm minigun on the cage: a wall of bullets.
qilin_mg.name: Qilin Minigun
qilin_mg.pattern: ST Kinetics LSV Mk II with a minigun

quadbike.desc: A scout on a quad: quick and quiet, gone at the first burst.
quadbike.name: Quadbike

rhib.desc: Fast, open and unarmed: six men up the river or along the coast, landed on any beach or bank.
rhib.name: RHIB

rhino.desc: A tank's gun on eight wheels: hits like an MBT, moves like an APC, armoured like one too.
rhino.name: Rhino MGS
rhino.pattern: Rooikat 8x8 with the 120 mm MTTD turret

rhino_up.desc: Urban package: reactive armour and slat cages against RPGs, a remote .50 cal against the men carrying them.
rhino_up.name: Rhino MGS UP
rhino_up.pattern: Rooikat MTTD with ERA, slat cages and an RCWS

sandstorm.desc: Twelve-tube rocket launcher: saturates an area with a ripple of rockets, then a long reload. Select it for fire missions.
sandstorm.name: M5 Sandstorm
sandstorm.pattern: Merkava IV hull with an M270 launcher

scorcher.desc: 155 mm self-propelled gun: halts, lays its barrel and drops three heavy shells on anything spotted 45-240 m away. Select it for fire missions.
scorcher.name: M4 Scorcher
scorcher.pattern: Merkava IV hull with an M109A7-style 155 mm turret

slammer.desc: Front-engined MBT with a troop compartment: carries a fire team behind the engine and the 120 mm.
slammer.name: M2A1 Slammer

slammer_up.desc: Urban package: reactive armour all round and a remote .50 cal.
slammer_up.name: M2A4 Slammer UP
slammer_up.pattern: Merkava Mk IV with reactive armour and an RCWS

sochor.desc: Self-propelled howitzer: three heavy shells on anything spotted 45-240 m away. Select it for fire missions.
sochor.name: 2S9 Sochor
sochor.pattern: T-100 hull with a 152 mm turret (2S35-like)

speedboat_hmg.desc: CSAT's riverine craft: 40 mm grenade launcher and a heavy machine gun, room for a squad.
speedboat_hmg.name: Speedboat HMG

speedboat_minigun.desc: Armoured riverine craft: a 40 mm grenade machine gun in the bow and room for a squad - puts men ashore under its own fire.
speedboat_minigun.name: Speedboat Minigun

stomper.desc: Six-wheeled robot with a .50 cal and a grenade launcher. Slow, tough, nobody inside to lose.
stomper.name: UGV Stomper RCWS

strider.desc: Low, quiet reconnaissance car with a sensor mast: sees far, hard to see.
strider.name: Strider

strider_gmg.desc: Fennek scout car with a grenade machine gun.
strider_gmg.name: Strider GMG

strider_hmg.desc: Fennek scout car with a remote .50 cal.
strider_hmg.name: Strider HMG

tank.desc: Smashes walls. Small arms bounce off.
tank.name: Battle Tank

taru.desc: Sky-crane with a cargo pod: flies supply straight to your neediest FOB over cut roads.
taru.name: Mi-290 Taru
taru.pattern: CH-54 Tarhe sky-crane with Ka-226 rotors

taru_lift.desc: The sky-crane without its pod: picks up a technical, a BTR or an AA truck on its sling and sets it down across the river or behind the enemy's line.
taru_lift.name: Mi-290 Taru (Lift)
taru_lift.pattern: CH-54 Tarhe sky-crane with Ka-226 rotors

tayran.desc: CSAT's quadcopter: circles a spot and shows everything within 70 m to your side. Cheap, quiet, easy to shoot down.
tayran.name: AR-2 Tayran

technical.desc: Fast pickup with a heavy machine gun.
technical.name: Technical

tempest.desc: Armoured six-wheeler: a fighter cell safe from rifle fire on the way in.
tempest.name: Tempest Transport

tempest_ammo.desc: Armoured ammunition truck: rearms troops and vehicles within 13 m.
tempest_ammo.name: Tempest Ammo

tempest_medical.desc: Armoured ambulance: treats the wounded within 11 m.
tempest_medical.name: Tempest Medical

tempest_repair.desc: Armoured workshop: repairs vehicles within 13 m.
tempest_repair.name: Tempest Repair

tigris.desc: Twin 35 mm and eight missiles under a radar: the end of any helicopter that comes near.
tigris.name: ZSU-39 Tigris
tigris.pattern: BM-2T Stalker hull with a Marksman twin 35 mm turret

van_ambulance.desc: A van turned ambulance: treats the wounded within 11 m.
van_ambulance.name: Van Ambulance

van_transport.desc: Minibus: a fighter cell arrives looking like anybody else's traffic.
van_transport.name: Van Transport

varsuk.desc: 125 mm, reactive armour, a big bustle: CSAT's workhorse tank.
varsuk.name: T-100 Varsuk

zamak.desc: Six-wheeled army truck under a canvas tilt: a whole fighter cell rides in the back.
zamak.name: Zamak Transport

zamak_ammo.desc: Allied ammunition truck: rearms troops and vehicles within 13 m.
zamak_ammo.name: Zamak Ammo

zamak_medical.desc: Allied ambulance truck: treats the wounded within 11 m.
zamak_medical.name: Zamak Medical

zamak_mrl.desc: Captured rocket truck: a ripple of rockets on anything spotted 60-250 m away, then a long reload. Select it for fire missions.
zamak_mrl.name: Zamak MRL

zamak_repair.desc: Workshop truck: repairs vehicles within 13 m.
zamak_repair.name: Zamak Repair
